API ReferenceZscaler Private Access APIPolicy ManagementUpdate a rule in a policy.
Update a rule in a policy.
PUT
https://api.zsapi.net/zpa/mgmtconfig/v2/admin/customers/:customerId/policySet/:policySetId/rule/:ruleId

Update a rule in a policy.

Request
​

int64
REQUIRED

int64
REQUIRED

int64
REQUIRED

The unique identifier of a rule in a policy.
